speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Granular yellow-white opacities around the retinal vessels and multiple areas of dot-blot hemorrhages; CD4_T-lymphocyte count: 36/mm3.

speaker: Patient
text: 34-year-old male. The patient presents with a 2-day history of decreased vision and seeing black spots in the right eye. He reports no pain, and the left eye is asymptomatic. He mentions being treated for fungal esophagitis 6 months ago and was diagnosed with Kaposi's sarcoma 2 years ago.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Decreased vision and black spots in the right eye. I also have No pain, Left eye is asymptomatic.

speaker: Doctor
text: I understand your anxiety, and given your history of AIDS, we must consider opportunistic infections like Cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis. Based on your symptoms and the urgency you feel, let me proceed with the diagnosis: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) Retinitis.
